## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] My commits follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) style.
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (lint, type-check, tests).
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for my change where relevant.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation where relevant.
- [ ] My change does not add any proprietary or license-restricted data (e.g. BADA datasets).
